name: python-counter-rollup
title: Python counter rollup
blurb: Fold monotonic counter readings into fixed-width windows: restart detection, missing scrapes that stay missing, idempotent merges of at-least-once rollups, and a rate that refuses when nothing was observed.
default_description: Turn counter readings into per-window quantities you can defend.
